review_items.title: 'Active approval' proposed as permission to receive — treat APR-SF-0311, -0327 and -0348 as permitted?
review_items.detail: The structured lane reads approval.status = 'active' as 'the facility may receive this stream'. Modification 4 removed F024 from Tank Farm B on 1 July 2026, and no other unit at Sabine Fuels may hold it. Accepting the proposal would make 'approved' mean 'permitted' in every answer, and the three exceptions, and the two loads received since, would disappear.

actions.label: Create a 'permitted' state from the permit version in force

evidence: LWPB-HW-7720-M4_Modification_4_Final.pdf §1: F024 removed from Tank Farm B; no other unit authorized
approvals.approval: APR-SF-0311, -0327, -0348 status active, codes F024 D001
September review deck slide 3: 'No permit-fit exceptions reported'

review_items.title: 'Brazos Bend Chem. Co.' (SF-0457) and Brazos Bend Chemical (C-10458, CE-2291) — same customer, merge?
review_items.detail: C-10458 and CE-2291 share EPA ID TXX910000131. The Sabine billing record SF-0457 has no EPA ID; it matches on name and address only ('2200 Bend Industrial Parkway').
evidence: Coastline integration status: CE-2291 held, same EPA ID as C-10458
msg_011 Kevin Park: three VLS invoices for similar rinse water

review_items.title: Gulfport Polymers LLC and Gulfport Polymer Services — merge on name?
review_items.detail: The names differ by one word. The EPA IDs (TXX910000158, LAX910000224), states and streams differ. Merging would attach a Louisiana polymer-services stream to a Texas polymer plant.

review_items.title: WP-20233 in VLS core and WP-20233 in Coastline legacy — same profile?
review_items.detail: The number is reused: Anselm Pharma Gulf's aqueous acid rinse in core, Palomino Metal Works' spent chromic etch in Coastline. Profile identity is scoped by source system.

review_items.title: DSC-BR-2026-0231 status 'Resolved' → reconciled?
review_items.detail: Receiving set the status to Resolved on 16 October, day 12. No written confirmation from the generator or transporter and no corrected manifest is on record. The extractor proposed a RECONCILED_BY edge from the status change.

actions.label: Keep open — status is not reconciliation

review_items.title: Modification 4: draft (effective 15 July, 30-day transition) or final (effective 1 July, no transition)?
review_items.detail: Both documents are in the Sabine permits folder. The extractor read an effective date from each. The final is approved; the draft was issued for comment and never approved.

actions.label: Use the final; keep the draft as a statement

review_items.title: CON-HT-2026-0810 → Bayou Ridge, matched on the log's date and destination — add the onward link?
review_items.detail: The consolidation of 12 August carries Marsh Point's 11 August load and two non-hazardous loads. Its onward manifest is blank. The extractor proposed a link to a Bayou Ridge receipt of the same day. A certificate needs a recorded link, not an inferred one.

actions.label: Keep unlinked until Harbor records it

evidence: SOP-HT-03 step 7: onward number within 24 hours

review_items.title: Brinemarsh Resins (TXX910000184) → Saltgrass Resins (TXX910000489): same site, link as predecessor?
review_items.detail: The Saltgrass Crossing resin plant changed owner; the new owner re-notified on 1 February 2026 and the Texas Waste Stewardship Commission (fictional) issued a new EPA ID, as it does on a change of owner (federally an ID usually stays with the site). The ten months of warehouse history before that sit under the old ID. Proposed: a predecessor link, not a merge.
evidence: same site address 9 Resin Rd, Saltgrass Crossing

pivot.title: 'Active approval' proposed as permission to receive — treat APR-SF-0311, -0327 and -0348 as permitted?
pivot.detail: The structured lane reads approval.status = 'active' as 'the facility may receive this stream'. Modification 4 removed F024 from Tank Farm B on 1 July 2026, and no other unit at Sabine Fuels may hold it. Accepting the proposal would make 'approved' mean 'permitted' in every answer, and the three exceptions, and the two loads received since, would disappear.
pivot.why_pivot: This item changes what a word means, not what a row says. Accepting it would make 'approved' mean 'permitted' in every answer, remove three permit-fit exceptions, and repeat September's 'no exceptions reported'.
evidence: LWPB-HW-7720-M4_Modification_4_Final.pdf §1: F024 removed from Tank Farm B; no other unit authorized

options.label: Keep approved and permitted distinct
options.consequence: Answers report 118 active approvals · 3 permit-fit exceptions · 2 loads received after 1 Jul.

options.consequence: Adds a state; 'permitted' is then computed per receipt date, never read from the approval.

nodes.label: Facility
nodes.sublabel: A receiving or transfer site with its EPA ID. Harbor Transfer is a transfer facility, not a TSDF.

nodes.label: Permit
nodes.sublabel: A facility's hazardous waste permit. The permit version in force on the date of receipt is the authority for accepted codes.

nodes.label: PermitModification
nodes.sublabel: A dated change to a permit. Approval date, effective date and filing date are kept apart.

nodes.label: PermitUnit
nodes.sublabel: A permitted unit (tank farm, receiving tank, container area) and the waste codes it may hold.

nodes.label: WasteCode
nodes.sublabel: An EPA hazardous waste code or the state non-hazardous class.

nodes.label: Well
nodes.sublabel: A Class I injection well and its well permit.

nodes.label: Exemption
nodes.sublabel: The no-migration exemption: the codes and limits under which land disposal restrictions do not apply.

nodes.label: Limit
nodes.sublabel: A concentration or physical limit in a permit or exemption. An approval's tolerance is a separate, tighter business rule.

nodes.label: Generator
nodes.sublabel: A generating site, keyed by its EPA ID. A change of owner can change the EPA ID.

nodes.label: CustomerAccount
nodes.sublabel: An account in one billing or customer system. Several accounts can belong to one customer.

nodes.label: Broker
nodes.sublabel: A waste broker shipping for several generators; never collapsed into the generator.

nodes.label: Profile
nodes.sublabel: A waste profile: composition, basis of each value, and re-certification date. Scoped by source system.

nodes.label: Approval
nodes.sublabel: The decision to accept a profile at a facility, with fingerprint tolerances. Approved is not permitted.

nodes.label: LabReport
nodes.sublabel: A laboratory report: measured values, method and date. Measured is not declared.

nodes.label: Manifest
nodes.sublabel: A hazardous waste manifest: 9 digits and 3 letters. A consolidation starts a new one.

nodes.label: Receipt
nodes.sublabel: A load received at a gate, with its scale weight and fingerprint results.

nodes.label: Discrepancy
nodes.sublabel: A difference between manifest and receipt. Significant ones carry a 20-day reconciliation clock from receipt.

nodes.label: Rejection
nodes.sublabel: A rejected load, with its 60-day window to arrange onward transport.

nodes.label: Consolidation
nodes.sublabel: A Harbor Transfer consolidation: inbound manifests linked to one onward manifest.

nodes.label: Certificate
nodes.sublabel: A certificate of disposal; it covers only loads with an unbroken chain from receipt to disposal.

nodes.label: ExportConsent
nodes.sublabel: An EPA export consent for hazardous waste fuel sent abroad.

nodes.label: Contract
nodes.sublabel: Standard terms, a service agreement or a price schedule.

nodes.label: Clause
nodes.sublabel: A regulatory provision or a contract clause that sets a condition.

nodes.label: Condition
nodes.sublabel: A condition stated in a permit, profile or approval.

nodes.label: Rule
nodes.sublabel: A governed rule from a plan or procedure that answers must follow.

nodes.label: Obligation
nodes.sublabel: A report or deliverable owed to a regulator, a customer or management, with its clock.

nodes.label: Organization
nodes.sublabel: An agency, a receiving facility outside VLS or an acquired business.

nodes.label: Transporter
nodes.sublabel: A carrier named on manifests.

nodes.label: Person
nodes.sublabel: A named role holder who owns an item.

nodes.label: Statement
nodes.sublabel: A dated claim made in a document — evidence, never a record by itself.

nodes.label: Template
nodes.sublabel: A report or certificate template, or a prior deliverable used as one.

nodes.label: Measure
nodes.sublabel: A governed measure with a named definition, owner and date basis.

nodes.label: Active approval
nodes.sublabel: Approval with status Active, not expired, resting on the latest certified profile version

sanity_checks.question: Are all active approvals still valid against the current permits at their facilities?
sanity_checks.verdict: Answerable - approved and permitted kept apart
sanity_checks.verdict_body: Approval -> Profile codes, Approval -[FOR_UNIT]-> PermitUnit, PermitModification -> PermitUnit (version in force on the as-of date). Three Sabine Fuels approvals list F024, which M4 removed. It depends on rq1 staying 'keep distinct'.
sanity_checks.plan:
MATCH (a:Approval {status:'active'})-[:FOR_UNIT]->(u:PermitUnit)<-[:NARROWS]-(m:PermitModification)
MATCH (a)-[:LISTS_CODE]->(c:WasteCode)
WHERE NOT (u)-[:ACCEPTS]->(c)
RETURN a, u, m, c

sanity_checks.question: Is the Kestrel Bayou discrepancy on manifest 024121904GBF reconciled?
sanity_checks.verdict: Answerable - open, with the conversion basis
sanity_checks.verdict_body: Discrepancy -> Manifest -> Receipt weight, converted by the declared density rule; the 20-day clock from receipt. The system's 'Resolved' status is held as a statement, not as reconciliation (rq5).
sanity_checks.plan:
MATCH (d:Discrepancy {id:'DSC-BR-2026-0231'})-[:ON_MANIFEST]->(m:Manifest)
MATCH (d)-[:CONVERTED_BY]->(r:Rule)
RETURN d, m, r

sanity_checks.question: Who is Brazos Bend Chemical across our systems, and what do they ship to us?
sanity_checks.verdict_body: Generator <- CustomerAccount (EPA ID) for C-10458 and CE-2291; SF-0457 by name and address only, shown separately until rq2 is decided. No source record is merged.

sanity_checks.question: Can we issue Marsh Point certificates of disposal for all 38 PFAS loads?
sanity_checks.verdict: Answerable - 37 of 38, the broken link named
sanity_checks.verdict_body: Obligation -> Manifest -> Consolidation -> onward Manifest -> Bayou Ridge. CON-HT-2026-0810 has no onward link; the inferred link is rejected (rq7), so the load is listed separately.
sanity_checks.plan:
MATCH (o:Obligation {id:'certificate_marsh_point'})-[:COVERS_LOAD|CANNOT_COVER]->(m:Manifest)-[:CONSOLIDATED_INTO]->(c:Consolidation)
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:ONWARD_ON]->(n:Manifest)
RETURN m, c, n

sanity_checks.question: What was the total volume received in the Gulf Coast region over the last 12 months?
sanity_checks.verdict: Answerable - onward shipments not double counted
sanity_checks.verdict_body: Receipts by facility, less Harbor Transfer's onward shipments received again at Bayou Ridge and Sabine Fuels: 59.7M gal from generators, not the 63.2M sum of gates.
sanity_checks.plan:
MATCH (r:Receipt) WHERE r.received >= date('2025-10-01')
OPTIONAL MATCH (r)<-[:ONWARD_ON]-(c:Consolidation)
RETURN sum(r.gal) - sum(CASE WHEN c IS NOT NULL THEN r.gal ELSE 0 END)

properties.rationale: An account ships for one generator; a broker account carries no generator_id and ships for several.
Each profile describes one stream from one generator site.
Versions are kept; a newer draft does not supersede a certified version.
A profile can hold approvals at more than one facility and superseded approvals over time.
Each approval sets its fingerprint parameters and bounds.
Accepted codes are listed per permit version and unit; the effective version on the as-of date governs.
One load received per manifest at a gate.
Loads are accepted under an approval; null on Harbor loads received before the cut-over.
About five fingerprint parameters per tested load.

Harbor Transfer consolidations after the cut-over; the onward manifest starts a new chain.

story_group.story: VLS Environmental Solutions runs the Gulf Coast hazardous waste region through three facilities: Bayou Ridge Disposal (Class I deep-well injection), Sabine Fuels (fuel blending) and Harbor Transfer (a 10-day transfer facility from the Coastline acquisition). A generator is a site keyed by its EPA ID; customer accounts in VLS core (C-10nnn), Sabine billing (SF-0nnn) and the frozen Coastline system (CE-2nnn) point at generators, and several accounts can be one customer. A profile describes one stream and records the basis of each value — laboratory analysis or generator knowledge. An approval accepts a profile at a facility and unit with fingerprint tolerances; it is not permission to receive, which comes from the permit version in force on the date of receipt. A load is received against a manifest and weighed; bulk quantities are compared by weight at the declared specific gravity. A significant discrepancy carries a 20-day clock from receipt; a status change is not reconciliation. Harbor Transfer consolidations start new manifests, so regional volume excludes onward shipments.

grain.Generators: one generator site x EPA ID
grain.Approvals: one approval (profile x facility x decision)
grain.Accepted_Codes: one permit version x unit x waste code
grain.Onward_Shipments: one inbound load x onward manifest

uncertainties: profile_version.waste_codes is a comma-separated list; permit fit needs it split and compared per unit.
approval.permit_unit is blank on approvals migrated from Coastline; the unit is inferred from the facility's code list.
receipt.approval_id is null on Harbor loads received before the 30 June cut-over.
discrepancy.status is set by receiving and can read 'Resolved' without a written confirmation.
onward_shipment starts on 1 July 2026; earlier consolidations are only in coastline.ce_shipment.
customer_account.generator_id is null on broker accounts.

type_links.reason: Documents name profiles by the WP number the profile table is keyed on — scoped by source system (WP-20233 is reused by Coastline).
Approval letters carry the APR number the approval table is keyed on.
Manifest tracking numbers in logs and letters match receiving.manifest keys.
Discrepancy ids in correspondence and reviews match receiving.discrepancy.
Consolidation ids in the Harbor log match onward_shipment.consolidation_id after the cut-over.
Account numbers in documents match customer_account; SF- numbers live in Sabine billing, not here.
An EPA ID identifies a generator site for one ownership period.
Permit extracts carry the permit id; the version comes from the modification history.
A final modification is a permit version with its own effective date. A draft is not.
Codes in permits and modifications are rows of permit_unit_code for that version and unit.
Codes on a profile are listed in profile_version.waste_codes.
profile_version.lab_report_ref points at the report; a lab report measures, a profile declares.
A generator's lab report is not a receiving fingerprint result.
Conditions in approval letters qualify the approval (permit version, notification).
Some conditions are tolerances; the approval_tolerance row is the record.
Quantities in documents may be manifested, weighed or converted — only the basis tells which.
A quantity in a letter is not a discrepancy unless receiving records one.
Approval, effective and filing dates of modifications bound the version in force.
A date in correspondence does not close a discrepancy.
Company names match generators only with an EPA ID; a name alone is a proposal (Gulfport Polymers ≠ Gulfport Polymer Services).
Names on accounts differ by system (BRAZOS BEND CHEMICAL, Brazos Bend Chem. Co.).
An approval is valid only at its facility.
Receipts are at a facility gate; Harbor Transfer is a transfer facility.
A named chemist is not a property of the approval decision.
40 CFR 264.72 sets the significant-discrepancy definition and the 20-day clock.
Prices in documents belong to price schedules per account; the billing dataset is the record.
Towns locate generator sites; no geocoding is connected.
